title: Preserving Provenance in Shared KV Caches for LLM Serving
selection_reason: The abstract studies shared KV-cache correctness across adapters, weights, and sharing domains, then proposes provenance-bound keys and a differential checker. It eliminates unsafe reuse while preserving legitimate sharing with low hit-path latency impact.
